result.description:
Wangara, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 14/07/2026 to 11/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17451
- Seeking experienced individuals for multiple positions
- Salary - $78,000 - $80,000
- Join Unique Metals Laser

Proudly Australian and privately owned company, Unique Metals Laser's history stretches back to 1972. Unique Metals Laser provide high precision cutting and fabrication solutions to a variety of industries. We have 8 sites across Australia, with our corporate office located in Coopers Plains,Queensland.

We are currently seeking to fill multiple full time roles within our company, including:
- Sheetmetal Tradesworker
- Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson-
- Metal Machinist (First Class)

Sheetmetal Tradesworker

Applicants must have a minimum of 2 years' experience in a similar role, and also hold a Certificate III in Engineering.

Duties and Responsibilities include:
- Welding and fabrication of various works
- Aluminium, Stainless and Mild steel welding - Mig and Tig
- Interpret drawings and specifications
- Fit and assembly of components into final products by welding, riveting, or otherwise joining
- Performing QA checks
- Polishing, filing, sanding, TIG brush, or cleaning assembled products

Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson

Applicants must have at least 2 years' experience in a similar role.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Prepare, coordinate and monitor the assigned engineering projects
- Prepare plans with detailed drawings that include project specifications and cost estimates
- Design and execute engineering experiments to create solutions
- Develop engineering diagrams and technical reports
- Complete required technical and regulatory documents

Metal Machinist

Applicants must have a minimum of 2 years' experience in a similar role in a manufacturing environment.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Setting and operating a CNC machine
- Reviewing job specifications and analysing drawings
- Ensuring component quality
- Using precision measuring instruments
- Materials handling
- Operating a forklift
- Ad hoc tasks as directed by Production Manager

The successful applicants for the above roles will be offered a salary between $78,000 - $80,000.

If you have the right skills and experience, apply now through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17451.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.

result.description:
Flowrite Group is a prominent leader and trusted name in the earthworks, demolition, and civil industry. Our unwavering commitment to delivering top-notch quality work sets us apart. We believe that every project, no matter the scale, deserves the utmost attention to detail and excellence. This dedication to excellence, combined with our modern fleet of machinery, allows us to consistently exceed our clients’ expectations.

At Flowrite Group, we recognise that our success is a result of the exceptional team we have cultivated. We place great emphasis on fostering a positive work environment that promotes collaboration, innovation, and growth.

We are seeking highly skilled Welders to join our team of passionate professionals who share a common drive to make a difference in the industry.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

result.description: TJHIN FAMILY HOLDINGS PTY LTD  We are currently seeking a full-time Computer Network and Systems Engineer for our business located in Sydney, New South Wales.  Your duties will include:   To lead the design, implementation, and management of the digital and physical security infrastructure for our commercial real estate portfolio. This role is responsible for ensuring that all properties (including HQ, Ipswich, and Fremantle) possess robust, secure, and high-performing network systems that support our investment goals, protect sensitive family office data, and provide seamless connectivity for our commercial tenants.  researching, analysing, evaluating and monitoring network infrastructure to ensure networks are configured to operate at optimal performance  assessing and recommending improvements to network operations and integrated hardware, software, communications and operating systems  providing specialist skills in supporting and troubleshooting network problems and emergencies  installing, configuring, testing, maintaining and administering new and upgraded networks, software database applications, servers and workstations  providing network programming in support of specific business needs and requirements  preparing and maintaining procedures and documentation for network inventory, and recording diagnosis and resolution of network faults, enhancements and modifications to networks, and maintenance instructions  monitoring network traffic, and activity, capacity and usage to ensure continued integrity and optimal network performance      In return you will receive:   Package: $80,000 - $90,000 per annum plus superannuation  Position: Full time (38 hours a week)  Paid travel interstates (including accommodation and transport)  Learning opportunity to upskill your career  Ongoing support from our team   Requirements of position   Relevant Bachelor's degree and at least 1 year of relevant work experience, or 5 years of relevant experience to substitute formal qualification.      If you are interested in this position, please send us your resume.     Please note only email applications will be accepted and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  About Company     Tjhin Family Holdings Pty Ltd operates a growing portfolio of commercial properties across multiple Australian states including New South Wales, Queensland (Ipswich region), and Western Australia (Fremantle region). The company has experienced significant growth, expanding from 1 property in 2024 to 3 properties currently, with planned acquisition of an additional 2 properties in future plan in different states. This expansion necessitates scalable IT infrastructure, integrated systems, and dedicated technical expertise to maintain operational efficiency across geographically distributed assets spanning approximately 4,000 kilometers. result.description:
The Ostojic Group are currently seeking experienced personnel to fill a number of Welder positions in our Darwin Workshop.

The position is responsible for the construction, assembly, maintenance and repair of stationary steam boilers and boiler house auxiliaries.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
